comment: The UI components of the Smart HOme Figma file: variant properties and transitions. Read by the Rust library (src/transitions.rs, include_str!) and by the Figma generator (ui-lib's design/components-patch.js). Change both sides by changing this file. One owner per component: with "figma": true its set is the one the designers drew in Figma (design/source/library.json, fetched by design/fetch-library.sh) and "parts" are the layers every variant must have; otherwise the generator draws it. "helper_sets": more sets the generator draws for a component. design/WORKFLOW.md has the workflow.

button.value: #button/pressed opacity (pressed): set by code, not a variant; size: the design's width (200, 116), the label centred

icon_button.value: #icon-button/pressed opacity (pressed): set by code, not a variant; icon: the design's icons; size: 56, 48

toggle.value: #toggle/thumb progress marker meter, #toggle/on opacity: set by code, not a variant

dropdown.value: #dropdown/list opacity (open), #dropdown/item/N/selected opacity: set by code, not a variant

list_item.value: the roles of Material 3's list item: #list-item/title (headline), /subtitle (supporting text, not in lines one), #list-item/pressed opacity (pressed): set by code. Slots #list-item/leading (kind icon) and #list-item/trailing (kinds plain, icon): instances of #icon, the glyph set by code, the trailing one shown or hidden. Kind image: #list-item/image (a picture the app registered, set by code) and #list-item/trailing-text. Kind text: a label (#list-item/title) and its value (#list-item/trailing-text, right aligned), lines one only. lines: one and two (72) for the kinds plain, icon, toggle and chevron, two and three (128, headline and supporting text up to two lines each) for image. Rows of a scrolling list (ListView, harry glue list()): a clipping slot, rows pitch apart, drag/fling as Android

scrollbar.value: the thumb of a scrolling list: #scrollbar/thumb vertical progress marker (0..100 along the track), the clone fades out 300 ms after the content stopped (transition hide); one value of length per list height in the design

icon.value: a glyph, 24 px (Lucide): for the slots of other components; no state

segmented.value: Material 3's segmented button, one choice of 2 to 4: per segment #segmented/segment-<i> (a touch target), /selected (the accent highlight), /label (ink2) and /label-selected (white); the choice lights a segment by opacity, the labels set by code; not a variant

tabs.value: Material 3's tabs, the screen's navigation (a segmented button picks a value, tabs switch screens): per tab #tabs/tab-<i> (a touch target) with #tabs/tab-<i>/selected (the white pill), /label (ink2) and /label-selected (accent, semi bold) lit by opacity, set by code, not a variant; the labels set by code

tile.value: a device's card: #tile/symbol/<icon> stacked at opacity 0 (the code lights one), #tile/title, #tile/subtitle, #tile/value; the control drawn with the library: #tile/toggle, #tile/slider, #tile/segmented, #tile/minus and #tile/plus, #tile/image (a picture on a plain frame); #tile/pressed opacity; a tap on the tile opens the device, the control inside takes its own taps (#tile/toggle, #tile/slider, the segments, #tile/minus and #tile/plus)

skeleton.value: a placeholder while content loads (Material's skeleton loader): grey shapes where the content will be, a heading bar, four text lines or a 16:9 picture, 440 or 832 wide (wide: a side panel's 880 content less 24 on each side); a light band (#skeleton/shimmer/1..3, horizontal progress markers with the same travel) sweeps across it while loading (change sweep, repeated from the start), still when not; the app fades it out with change hide when the content shows. Display only: the clone takes no taps

symbol.value: display only: the tile of a room's or a device's symbol (48, the soft accent, the glyph #symbol/icon in ink)

keyboard.value: #kbd/<key>/pressed opacity (pressed): set by code; one component, not a set

slider.value: #slider/fill progress bar meter, #slider/thumb progress marker meter: set by code, not a variant

bar_chart.value: display only: #bar-chart/bar/<1..24> vertical progress bar meters (the level, 0..100), #bar-chart/bar/<i>/accent the same bar in the accent colour, shown by opacity

overlay.value: an overlay over the screen: the variant is the state, harry animates the change with the open/close transitions; one set per overlay in the app's design. The moving parts carry the same animation as the instance: harry gives a variant change's children no animation of their own

form.value: an overlay with input fields (slots): a tap focuses a field, the screen's keyboard dock opens and types into it; one set per form in the app's design, state first

keyboard_dock.value: the screen's one keyboard: an overlay at the bottom with the #keyboard component in its slot (#<app>/keys), open while a field has the focus; the instance stays closed and the app moves the slot (keys_position)

input_field.value: #input-field/focus opacity (focused), #input-field/caret blinks by opacity, #input-field/placeholder opacity (empty), texts: set by code, not a variant

sheet.value: the library's container for anything over the screen: #sheet/scrim (opacity 0 to 35 %) and #sheet/card, a dialog 1120 wide in the middle, as high as its content plus 40 around it (the card hugs the content; the app reads the content's height from the .dcf, design.rs), or a panel along an edge, half the screen; #sheet/content is an empty slot for the app's content. The app gives the card its position (FollowPositionCustomizer, ui-lib sheet.rs: the closed card waits 40 px behind its edge, a dialog is centred by its content's height) and the scrim its opacity, so open and close are display-only; the app never sets the instance's variant (the Library's variant has no content)
